텔레비전 추리 드라마를 보며 범인을 짐작해 본 적이 있다면 이미 절반은: If you have ever guessed the culprit while watching a TV crime drama, you already know half of it. In a murder mystery you play one of the suspects. Sitting around a table, everyone asks and answers questions and pieces together what happened that day. Unlike games where you move pieces or roll dice, the conversation is the game.
상자 안에는 등장인물 수만큼 대본이 들어 있습니다. 한 사람이 한 인물을: The box holds one character booklet per character. Each person plays one.
내 인물이 그날 무엇을 했는지, 누구와 어떤 사이인지, 남에게 숨기고 싶: It tells you what your character did that day, how they know the others, and what they would rather hide. Don't show it to anyone.
돌아가며 내 인물이 누구인지 소개합니다. 대본에 적힌 내용을 내 말투로: Take turns introducing your character. Just say what the booklet says, in your own words.
규칙서 순서대로 단서 카드를 펼치고, 서로 묻고 답합니다. 앞뒤가 안 맞: Reveal clue cards in the order the rulebook gives and question each other. Whatever doesn't add up becomes a lead.
각자 범인이라고 생각하는 사람을 고릅니다. 마지막에 해설을 읽으면 그날: Everyone names the person they suspect. Reading the solution at the end reveals everything that happened that night.
연기를 잘해야 하나요?: Do I need to be good at acting?
아닙니다. 목소리나 말투를 바꿀 필요가 없습니다. 대본에 적힌 내용을 평: No. You don't need to change your voice or manner. Passing on what's in the booklet in your usual way is enough.
추리를 잘 못하는데 괜찮을까요?: I'm not good at puzzles. Is that all right?
혼자 푸는 시험이 아니라 여럿이 이야기하며 맞춰 가는 놀이입니다. 범인을: It isn't a test you sit alone; the group works it out by talking. Even if you miss the culprit, the solution at the end tells you the whole story.
범인을 맡은 사람은 들키지 않도록 말을 고르게 됩니다. 범인이 아니어도: Whoever plays the culprit chooses their words so as not to be caught. Even the others have something to hide, so part of the fun is deciding what to share and what to keep back.
인원이 모자라면 할 수 있나요?: Can we play with fewer people?
인물 수가 정해져 있어서, 작품에 적힌 인원이 모여야 합니다. 가족 모임: Each game has a fixed number of characters, so you need the player count shown. It suits family gatherings or evenings with friends where the numbers match.
작품마다 적힌 시간을 기준으로 하되, 처음이라면 규칙서를 함께 읽는 시간: Go by the time shown for each game, and allow extra for reading the rulebook together the first time. It helps if one person reads the rulebook aloud and leads.
한 사건은 한 번 즐기는 놀이입니다. 범인과 해설을 알고 나면 같은 사건: Each case is meant to be played once. Once you know the culprit and the solution, you can't solve the same case again. You can lend the box to another group or run the game for them.
내가 맡은 인물의 이야기와 비밀이 적힌 작은 책입니다. 인물 책자, 캐릭: A small booklet with your character's story and secrets, also called a character sheet.
A card showing an object or record found at the scene or among belongings.
Choosing the person you think did it, also called the vote.
The final text that reveals every secret, also called the ending.
아직 하지 않은 사람에게 범인이나 결말을 미리 알려 주는 일입니다. 한: Telling someone who hasn't played who did it or how it ends. Since each case is played once, take extra care.
